evidence_items.publisher: Gadget Review, syndicated by Yahoo Finance
evidence_items.locator: Section: Revenue Tripled. Costs Outran It Anyway.

receipt.public_excerpt: But total costs and expenses reached $34 billion, producing an operating loss of $20.92 billion.

evidence_items.explanation: This corroborates the expense figure but identifies $20.92 billion as operating loss. It supplies no depreciation-and-amortization reconciliation establishing EBITDA.

metric_scope.metric: Total costs and expenses; operating loss

evidence_items.publisher: Financial Times, syndicated by Yahoo Finance

receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI booked about $13bn in revenue last year.

evidence_items.explanation: Independent reporting identifies the approximately $13 billion figure as revenue. That supports concern about the sentence's labeling but does not measure EBITDA.

evidence_items.locator: Section: Gotta spend money to make money, opening sentence

receipt.public_excerpt: Operating numbers aside, OpenAI’s headline “net loss” number of just over $5 billion in 2024 ballooned to nearly $39 billion in 2025.

evidence_items.explanation: The reported net loss also differs from $13.07 billion. Net loss is a different metric and cannot decide the EBITDA-margin claim.

unresolved_gaps: The underlying audited statements and a complete EBITDA reconciliation were not retrieved.
Depreciation and amortization amounts needed to distinguish operating loss from EBITDA are missing.
The sentence contains conflicting labels and signs; correcting them does not by itself validate the EBITDA margin.
